criteria: Loading, empty, error and success states designed
Motion spec has reduced motion and budgets

findings.finding: DC-H1 Resort name spelled 'Jazz Casa del Mar' everywhere; brief and FR-16 say 'Jaz Elite Casa del Mar Beach'. Steven to choose real name, short form or neutral codename at T2. STATUS: not fixed by design; becomes a T2 decision for Steven.

DC-H2 No 3D has been seen before T2; only flat SVG posters exist. Scrim 0.84 to 0.92 and short scene bands make it less immersive than the brief. Produce at least a Home hero still or spike capture before T2. STATUS: accepted by Steven in chat 2026-10-16: "skip the 3D hero preview ... I will judge the look blindly."
DC-H3 Admin session timeout warning (AC-51.3, NFR-5, WCAG 2.2.1) is not designed. STATUS: fixed and re-reviewed 2026-10-16 (see docs/reviews/phase4-rereview.md).

DC-H4 No screen for site wide text (navigation, footer, form labels, messages), no Pages index, no consent and privacy line editor with wording versions (FR-35, AC-33.2, D-2). STATUS: fixed and re-reviewed 2026-10-16 (see docs/reviews/phase4-rereview.md).

A-1 Prototype JS runs in head without defer so menu, pause control and password toggle never bind (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.2.2, 4.1.2). STATUS: fixed and re-reviewed 2026-10-16 (see docs/reviews/phase4-rereview.md).
A-2 / DC-H3 Admin session timeout has no warning or extension (WCAG 2.2.1).
A-3 Sticky admin header obscures focus at 375 px (WCAG 2.4.11).
A-4 Horizontal scroll at 320 px on public (323 px) and admin pages (339 px) (WCAG 1.4.10).
A-5 Loader loops run up to 8 s with no pause, against spec 3.6 s (WCAG 2.2.2).
DC-M1 First 3D frame budget not measurable as specified: Lighthouse simulated throttling cannot show a 4 s first frame; use applied (CDP) throttling; margin only 0.15 to 0.25 s.
DC-M2 Quality governor judges frame interval so 30 Hz devices (Low Power Mode, battery saver) fall to the poster; judge per frame work time instead.

DC-M3 Motion plan heavy for a concept: build Home hero first, build the five section scenes from one parametrised diorama kit, make pixel match and flash checks manual, drop the motion library if CSS lightbox works.
DC-M4 Loader covers an already drawn page, hides the concept notice and has a 620 ms exit; shorten exit and show the concept sentence or confirm with legal.
DC-M5 German and Russian layouts untested between 960 and 1280 px; hero heading rule breaks for long names.
DC-M6 Only 6 of 21 page types prototyped; Gallery lightbox, Offers, Dining, Location, legal pages and states lack visuals; lazy images not captured in 375 screenshots.
DC-M7 Designs hide Maps link when empty (FR-39 says it may not be empty); Should screens (US-35, US-78) not marked outside MVP.

Design lows: stale open items in motion spec (L1); reduced motion contradiction in scene-areas (L2); contrast figures disagree 8:1 vs 6.8:1 (L3); Explore tile columns disagree (L4); tilt control and label mismatches (L5); 'Ask about this suite' loses context (L6); booking wording is a third party claim (L7); static map source not chosen (L8); generator scripts not in repo (L9); hover lift not limited to fine pointers (L10); swup head plugin and html lang on language change (L11); duplicate id book-note-1; card link targets 33 px; rich text textbox labelling; text spacing clipping on cards.
findings.where: see consultant and accessibility reports summarised in docs/reviews/phase4-gate-findings.md

actions: Steven decides the resort name at T2 (DC-H1) and judges the 3D look blind (DC-H2).
Medium and low findings, plus the re-review items in docs/reviews/phase4-rereview.md, are known items taken to T2 by Steven's decision.
